info.name: Structural Design Patterns - Book Management System
info.description:
This collection demonstrates THREE structural design patterns working together in a Spring Boot Book Management System.

## Design Patterns Implemented:

### 1. ADAPTER PATTERN (BookMapper.java)
**Purpose**: Converts between incompatible interfaces
- Adapts `Book` entity ↔ `BookDto` for API layer
- Adapts `BookComponent` (decorator) ↔ `BookDto`
- **Used in**: ALL endpoints (via BookMapper.toDTO() calls)
- **Location**: `org.example.structural.utils.BookMapper`

### 2. FACADE PATTERN (LibraryFacade.java)
**Purpose**: Provides simplified interface to complex subsystems
- Hides complexity of BookService, decorators, and repository interactions
- Single point of entry for all library operations
- **Used in**: ALL endpoints (controller → facade → service)
- **Location**: `org.example.structural.service.LibraryFacade`

### 3. DECORATOR PATTERN (decorator/ package)
**Purpose**: Dynamically adds features to objects without modifying their class
- `FeaturedBookDecorator`: Adds [Featured] tag, applies 5% discount
- `BestsellerBookDecorator`: Adds [Bestseller] tag, applies 10% premium
- Supports decorator stacking (combine multiple decorators)
- **Used in**: /featured, /bestsellers, /{id}/featured, /{id}/bestseller, /{id}/featured-bestseller
- **Location**: `org.example.structural.service.decorator/`

## Pattern Collaboration:
Most endpoints use **MULTIPLE PATTERNS TOGETHER**:
- Basic operations: Facade + Adapter
- Decorator operations: Facade + Decorator + Adapter

## Base URL
http://localhost:8080

## Database Access
- H2 Console: http://localhost:8080/h2-console
- Swagger UI: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui/index.html
- JDBC URL: jdbc:h2:mem:librarydb
- Username: sa
- Password: password

## Patterns NOT Implemented:
The README mentions Bridge, Composite, Flyweight, and Proxy patterns as educational examples, but these are NOT implemented in the actual codebase.

item.name: Decorator Pattern Examples

request.description:
Retrieves all books with FeaturedBookDecorator applied to each.

**PATTERNS USED:**
- **FACADE**: LibraryFacade.getFeaturedBooks() applies decorator to entire collection
- **DECORATOR**: Each book wrapped in FeaturedBookDecorator ([Featured] tag + 5% discount)
- **ADAPTER**: BookMapper.toDTO() converts each decorated BookComponent → BookDto

**Code Flow**: Controller → LibraryFacade.getFeaturedBooks() → Gets all books → Wraps each in FeaturedBookDecorator → Stream of BookComponents → Map to DTOs → List<BookDto>

Every book in the response will have the [Featured] tag and discounted price.

Retrieves all books with BestsellerBookDecorator applied to each.

**PATTERNS USED:**
- **FACADE**: LibraryFacade.getBestsellers() applies decorator to entire collection
- **DECORATOR**: Each book wrapped in BestsellerBookDecorator ([Bestseller] tag + 10% premium)
- **ADAPTER**: BookMapper.toDTO() converts each decorated BookComponent → BookDto

**Code Flow**: Controller → LibraryFacade.getBestsellers() → Gets all books → Wraps each in BestsellerBookDecorator → Stream of BookComponents → Map to DTOs → List<BookDto>

Every book in the response will have the [Bestseller] tag and premium pricing.

- **ADAPTER**: BookMapper.toDTO(BookComponent) converts decorated book → BookDto

request.description:
Gets a book with BOTH decorators stacked together - the ultimate demonstration!

**PATTERNS USED (ALL THREE!):**
- **FACADE**: LibraryFacade.getFeaturedBestseller() manages complex decorator stacking
- **DECORATOR (STACKED!)**: Multiple decorators wrapped together
- **ADAPTER**: BookMapper.toDTO(BookComponent) handles the complex decorated object

**Code Flow**: 
Controller → LibraryFacade.getFeaturedBestseller(id) → Creates BasicBook(book) → Wraps with BestsellerBookDecorator → Wraps AGAIN with FeaturedBookDecorator → BookComponent → BookMapper.toDTO(component) → BookDto

**Stacked Decorator Behavior**:
1. BestsellerBookDecorator: Adds '[Bestseller]' + 10% premium
2. FeaturedBookDecorator: Adds '[Featured]' + 5% discount (applied to already-modified price)

**Result**: Description shows BOTH tags, price has BOTH modifications applied (premium then discount)

This showcases the true power of the Decorator pattern - unlimited stacking of behaviors at runtime!

item.description:
Endpoints demonstrating ALL THREE patterns working together:

1. **DECORATOR PATTERN**: Dynamically adds features to books
   - FeaturedBookDecorator: adds [Featured] tag + 5% discount
   - BestsellerBookDecorator: adds [Bestseller] tag + 10% premium
   - Can stack decorators (featured-bestseller endpoint)

2. **FACADE PATTERN**: LibraryFacade wraps decorator creation logic

3. **ADAPTER PATTERN**: BookMapper.toDTO(BookComponent) converts decorated books to DTOs

**Flow**: Controller → LibraryFacade → Creates BasicBook → Wraps with Decorator(s) → BookMapper converts BookComponent → BookDto → Client

This showcases how multiple structural patterns complement each other in a real application!
